map.→ 打开抗疲劳镜片下加光设计器工具: -> Open the anti-fatigue lens add power designer tool
map.下加光 Add = max(0, 100/工作距cm − (调节幅度 − 调节幅: Add power = max(0, 100/working distance in cm - (range of adjustment - range of adjustment/3)), quantised to 0.25 D and capped at 1.00 D
map.下加越大越好？: Is more add power always better?
map.不是。老花是中老年远用不清需全时加光；抗疲劳是年轻人视近加微光缓解疲劳，远用仍清: No. Presbyopia is blurred near and distance vision in middle age and older, needing add power at all times; anti-fatigue lenses give a slight add for near work to relieve fatigue in young people while distance vision stays clear.
map.与渐进片区别（仅下加、无远中近多焦）。: The difference from progressive lenses (add at the bottom only, with no distance, intermediate and near zones).
map.否。过大会致远用模糊与适应困难，按调节滞后量定，通常 ≤+0.75D。: No. Too much makes distance vision blurry and hard to adapt to; it is set from the amount of lag in the range of adjustment, usually +0.75D or less.
map.抗疲劳片=老花镜吗？: Are anti-fatigue lenses the same as reading glasses for presbyopia?
map.抗疲劳镜片下加光设计器 使用指南: Anti-fatigue lens add power designer guide
map.按 Hofstetter 平均调节幅度，保留 1/3 调节力，超出部分作为抗疲劳: Use the Hofstetter average amplitude of accommodation, keep one third of the accommodative power, and use the remainder as the add power for anti-fatigue lenses. The amplitude of accommodation = 18.5 - 0.30 x age.
map.视功能检查后定下加量。: Determine the added power after the visual function examination.
map.输入年龄、调节幅度与工作距离计算建议下加光 ADD(调节需求=100/距离cm): Enter age, accommodative amplitude, and working distance to compute the recommended near add ADD (accommodative demand = 100 / working distance in cm), design an anti-fatigue lens plan, and relieve near-vision fatigue.
map.长时间用眼者加轻度下加缓解调节紧张。: For people who do close-range work for long hours, add a mild near add to relieve accommodative strain.
map.：抗疲劳片仅在视近区加光，远用区平光，不同于渐进片的全景通道，适用 20–40: : Anti-fatigue lenses add power only in the near zone and keep the distance zone flat, unlike the all-distance channel of progressive lenses, so they suit people aged 20–40 with visual fatigue.
map.：长时间看屏、调节滞后者加 +0.50D～+0.75D 下加，缓解睫状肌紧张；若: : For long screen time with accommodative lag, add +0.50D to +0.75D of near add to relieve ciliary muscle strain; if convergence is insufficient, visual training is better than simply adding power.
